comment: The SQLite backend's instance guard (org.streamrune.sqlite.FlockFileLock) calls open(2), flock(2), close(2) and strerror(3) through the Foreign Function and Memory API on Linux and macOS. The legacy reflect-config.json and resource-config.json of this module have no foreign section, so the descriptors are registered here, in the reachability-metadata format, conditional on the guard class.
